newsitem.title: USA: Durakon buys back six pct of stock.
newsitem.headline: Durakon buys back six pct of stock.

text.p: Durakon Industries Inc said Thursday it has repurchased 400,000 shares of its common stock at $13 a share from two funds affiliated with Weiss, Peck & Greer LLC and Wesley Lang, a director of Durakon.
Prior to the repurchase, Durakon had approximately 6,565,000 shares of common stock outstanding.

"This repurchase of six percent of the company's outstanding common stock is an effective use of cash that we believe will have a positive impact on the value of our shareholders' investment," David W. Wright, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.

In a related development, Lang announced his resignation from Durakon's board. Lang said his decision was in keeping with the policy of Weiss, Peck and Greer that its principals do not serve on boards of companies in which neither Weiss, Peck & Greer nor its affiliates has a substantial interest.
Durakon produces and distributes pickup truck bedliners and rollback carriers, as well as makes tow trucks and distributes vehicle accessories.
